description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
